title: Final bit of the configuration word
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $C$ be a configuration of $N$ on input $x$, and let $s\in\mathbb{N}$. The bit of the encoded configuration word at index $W(2s+1)+w_P(|x|)$ is true, where $W$ is the chunk width and $w_P(|x|)$ is the padded input-position width.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
